description: List a country's official public holidays for one year, with the date, the weekday, the holiday's name and the day off when the law moves it (a Saturday or Sunday holiday). Send country (ISO 3166 two letters) and year, and region where holidays differ inside the country (United Kingdom: ENG, WLS, SCT or NIR). Covered: US (United States (federal)), GB (United Kingdom), DE (Germany (national days)), FR (France), IE (Ireland). Any other country is refused, not guessed. Use it for scheduling, due dates and delivery promises. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/public-holidays). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 country code: US, GB (or UK), DE, FR, IE.

region.description: United Kingdom only, required: ENG, WLS, SCT or NIR (GB-ENG form accepted). Not used for the other countries.

year.description: Calendar year. Each country has its own first and last year (United Kingdom 2007 to 2035, Germany 1995 to 2100, Ireland 2023 to 2100, others 1990 to 2100).
